item.title: Write About a Chalk Drawing in the Rain
item.prompt_text: You drew a chalk picture outside a community hall. Rain began and part of the picture disappeared. A friend showed you somewhere dry to start again. Write a short diary entry naming what you drew, what the rain changed, and what you did differently the second time.
item.audience: your English class's shared activity diary
item.target_grammar: Past simple and when for events. Use comparative words for the second picture.
item.target_structure: State what you drew, give the change, and finish with what you did the second time.

checklist.point: Say what you drew at first.
Describe what you did differently the next time.
